description: The root opens a line after another line became the default branch; the new line starts from the root and reports to it
message: Open one line to add a `--dry-run` option to cli.py with a test. While it works, update README.md with the new option and the project's test command.

switch.message: Now add a `--json` output option to report.py with a test. Open a new line for it, from your own history.

probes.text: after the default branch moved to the tool line, the root opens a new line with the branch tool in response to the user's second request
the new line is cut from the root's history and reports to the root, not to the line holding the default branch
the line holding the default branch does the --json work itself
